sentences.cn_text: 银行家们在公开场合为自己的困境进行自我检讨。
sentences.en_text: Bankers have been blaming themselves for their troubles in public.

sentences.cn_text: 而在幕后，他们却将矛头对准了另一群人：会计准则制定者。
sentences.en_text: Behind the scenes, they have been taking aim at someone else: the accounting standard-setters.

sentences.cn_text: 银行抱怨称，这些准则迫使它们报告巨额亏损，这实在不公平。
sentences.en_text: Their rules, moan the banks, have forced them to report enormous losses, and it’s just not fair.

sentences.cn_text: 这些准则要求银行必须按第三方愿意支付的价格对某些资产进行估值，而非按管理者和监管者所希望达到的价格估值。
sentences.en_text: These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch.

sentences.cn_text: 不幸的是，银行的游说活动如今似乎正在见效。
sentences.en_text: Unfortunately, banks’ lobbying now seems to be working.

sentences.cn_text: 具体细节或许难以知晓,但对资本市场正常运作至关重要的准则制定者独立性正在遭受损害。
sentences.en_text: The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised.

sentences.cn_text: 而且，除非银行以能够吸引买家的价格持有有毒资产，否则银行体系的复苏将困难重重。
sentences.en_text: And, unless banks carry toxic assets at prices that attract buyers, reviving the banking system will be difficult.

sentences.cn_text: 在与国会经历了一场激烈交锋后，美国财务会计准则委员会（FASB）火速推行了准则修订。
sentences.en_text: After a bruising encounter with Congress, America’s Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) rushed through rule changes.

sentences.cn_text: 这些修订赋予银行更大的自由度，允许其使用模型对非流动性资产进行估值，并在损益表中更灵活地确认长期资产损失。
sentences.en_text: These gave banks more freedom to use models to value illiquid assets and more flexibility in recognizing losses on long-term assets in their income statements.

sentences.cn_text: FASB主席鲍勃·赫兹对那些「质疑我们动机」的人强烈抗议。然而银行股应声上涨，而这些修订强化了某游说团体委婉称作「管理层判断的运用」的做法。
sentences.en_text: Bob Herz, the FASB’s chairman, cried out against those who “question our motives.” Yet bank shares rose and the changes enhance what one lobbying group politely calls “the use of judgment by management.”

tokens.gloss: 财务会计准则委员会的

sentences.cn_text: 欧洲各国部长立即要求国际会计准则理事会（IASB）效仿此举。
sentences.en_text: European ministers instantly demanded that the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) do likewise.

sentences.cn_text: IASB表示不愿在缺乏整体规划的情况下贸然行动，但在今年晚些时候完成准则重构时妥协的压力巨大。
sentences.en_text: The IASB says it does not want to act without overall planning, but the pressure to fold when it completes its reconstruction of rules later this year is strong.

sentences.cn_text: 欧盟委员查理·麦克里维警告IASB，称其「并非生活在政治真空中」而是「身处现实世界」，并表示欧洲仍可能制定不同的准则。
sentences.en_text: Charlie McCreevy, a European commissioner, warned the IASB that it did “not live in a political vacuum” but “in the real world” and that Europe could yet develop different rules.

sentences.cn_text: 真正脱离实际的是银行，它们的账目严重高估了资产价值。
sentences.en_text: It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets.

sentences.cn_text: 如今它们辩称市场价格夸大了损失，因为这些价格主要反映的是市场暂时性的流动性不足，而非坏账的实际规模。
sentences.en_text: Today they argue that market prices overstate losses, because they largely reflect the temporary illiquidity of markets, not the likely extent of bad debts.

sentences.cn_text: 真相需要数年后方能揭晓。
sentences.en_text: The truth will not be known for years.

sentences.cn_text: 但银行股价低于其账面价值，这表明投资者持怀疑态度。
sentences.en_text: But banks’ shares trade below their book value, suggesting that investors are skeptical.

sentences.cn_text: 而市场陷入停滞，部分原因在于银行处于瘫痪状态：它们既因担心确认账面损失而不愿出售资产，又不愿收购那些所谓的低价资产。
sentences.en_text: And dead markets partly reflect the paralysis of banks which will not sell assets for fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.

sentences.cn_text: 要使体系重新运转，就必须承认并处理损失。
sentences.en_text: To get the system working again, losses must be recognized and dealt with.

sentences.cn_text: 美国收购有毒资产的新计划能否奏效，取决于银行是否将资产标价至买家认为具有吸引力的水平。
sentences.en_text: America’s new plan to buy up toxic assets will not work unless banks mark assets to levels which buyers find attractive.

sentences.cn_text: 成功的市场需要独立甚至强硬的准则制定者。
sentences.en_text: Successful markets require independent and even combative standard-setters.

sentences.cn_text: FASB和IASB正是这样做的，例如在特殊利益集团的敌意下整顿了股票期权和养老金方面的准则。
sentences.en_text: The FASB and IASB have been exactly that, cleaning up rules on stock options and pensions, for example, against hostility from special interests.

sentences.cn_text: 但如今向批评者妥协，无异于招致要求更多让步的压力。
sentences.en_text: But by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more concessions.
